general.description: Toki no Namida means "Tears of time" in old Hekka / Japanese. Built from a hollowed moonlet orbiting Ashioto, this station was originally a policorporatist base and spaceyard, until it was taken by Harmand's Irregulars and became a major headquarter for the rebellion. After the Planetarist wars, it was refurbished into a transit station. Before the Ashioto Cluster was founded, it frequently hosted small traffics and acted as a meeting place for somewhat illegal business. Now, under the supervision of the Ashioto Cluster, these activities should have ended, but the place is still a crowded transit spacestation, still renowned for one of its restaurants who serve various nice meals from all the sophontness. Except the Aligot. Awful. Don't try it.
general.bar: This old-style restaurant is crowded with spacers, tourists and merchants, enjoying the view of Ashioto, that seems to slowly turn green again ...
